scope: unfixed HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerabilities in the pinned Debian Trixie runtime image
rationale: Trivy reports no FixedVersion for the listed CVEs. Full scan output remains retained. The exception is time-limited and does not waive fixed vulnerabilities, MEDIUM findings, misconfigurations, runtime smoke tests, or non-root checks.
required_owner_review: Review each CVE, package reachability and compensating controls; record approval identity, timestamp and review reference before promotion.
